duration: Environment refresh and acceptance are human checks
summary: Phase 3: save/reopen when needed, inspect real Verify results and accept the actual intended extension profile. CLI presence is not enterprise routing or runtime-health proof.

purpose.p: Separate known setup outcomes from real laptop acceptance before Restore or daily development.
New environment values may not reach an already open VS Code process. Retain installed tools and refresh the application, not global PATH or policy.

starting_state.p: Selected module/vendor/restart outcomes are known; no setup/app/test/Restore task still running. Save all editor work before a full exit.

steps.title: Save work and refresh VS Code's environment when needed
steps.where: Save all work › Fully exit VS Code › Reopen from Windows

body.p: A new terminal or Reload Window is not guaranteed to refresh values inherited by an existing VS Code process. Fully exit/reopen from Windows when required, keeping the intended profile and approved routing.
Do not reinstall discovered Python 3.14/pwsh or globally alter PATH/JAVA_HOME to mask a stale process environment.

steps.expect: Fresh application environment with the same retained tools/settings/profile, not an assumed successful setup.

steps.title: Read the selected Native or full verification result
steps.where: Native terminal command or separate full Verify task

body.p: Native positively checks 18 records: eight tools, five language/debugger extensions and all five policies. It does not query WSL/wslc, Azure or containers; Native Preflight does not require virtualization. Required Native FAIL/exit 1 stops that scope.

Full verification is a separate requested inventory, not a Native prerequisite. Its unchanged 33 records still require 16 tools and 12 extensions plus policies; missing WSL/stub timeout or wider extensions remain full FAIL/exit 1.

Json emits only the selected results array. IncludeJavaModernization remains the optional full thirteenth extension; Native cannot combine with modernization or RunConfigTest. Configuration tests remain separately approved provider work.

steps.expect: Native and full statuses reported separately; no ignored failure or full-readiness claim from Native PASS.

steps.title: Accept the selected Native or full profile and approved source
steps.where: VS Code › Extensions › Intended approved profile

body.p: Native needs its five language/debugger IDs enabled: ms-python.python, ms-python.debugpy, redhat.java, vscjava.vscode-java-debug and golang.go. The following table is the separate full profile, never a demand to install Azure/containers/WSL for Native.

head: Full required 12
Optional 13th only for modernization
rows: Never install it to turn Native green

body.p: Check actual enabled state, intended profile and corporate source routing. Recommendations and workspace settings are not policy enforcement. An extension ID list or private-marketplace banner alone is not acceptance.
GitHub authentication/Copilot access are separate human decisions; Verify does not inspect or repair accounts.

steps.expect: Genuine selected-profile/source/enabled-state acceptance plus positive Native or full Verify; Restore remains separately approved.

steps.title: Accept the positive Native scope without changing full readiness
steps.where: Workstation setup scope approval after actual Native JSON

body.p: Require every one of the 18 Native records positively PASS and exit 0, fresh required runtime evidence, known vendor/reboot safety and actual approved enabled-profile/source acceptance. Native never depends on an arbitrary ignore list or WSL stub message/timeout.

Malformed/unusable JSON, empty/partial/duplicate/unexpected rows, any required FAIL/unknown or runtime/profile/policy/source uncertainty stop. The human may decline narrower Native continuation; approval permits only a separate Dependencies Restore request.

RunLocal is the existing Native action, with Container=false. Full FAIL/exit 1 stays separately visible and dated; unrequested full verification is NOT RUN/not accepted. Native PASS does not prove F5, helper availability or live requests. Go Delve/helper acquisition remains separately approved Restore before debugging, never hidden in F5.

steps.expect: Positive Native prerequisites and meaningful human consent, not full workstation or debugger acceptance; Native tests/startup/requests still require real observation.

expected.p: Observed accepted laptop readiness or explicit blockers. The repository can be code-ready while the laptop remains unverified.

success.p: Record current results, selected runtime paths and actual intended-profile acceptance; then continue to [explicit Restore](page:develop-checks).

failures.symptom: Required Verify FAIL after intended setup
failures.cause: Missing/mismatched output, stale environment or unresolved setup result
failures.fix: Do not claim accepted. Read selected paths/version and safely refresh VS Code or review the failed named module with IT; no blind reinstall.

failures.symptom: Extension IDs exist but intended profile/source is unsupported
failures.cause: CLI listing does not establish enabled-state or corporate routing
failures.fix: Stop acceptance and require compatible IT-managed automated delivery. No public VSIX/profile/source bypass.

failures.symptom: wslc exists but runtime operation fails
failures.fix: Stop the runtime action and report it; do not switch to a different runtime to bypass the failure/denial.

recovery.p: Use read-only Verify/source review and preserve tools/settings/accounts/distro data. ConfigTest, Restore and setup are separate human-approved actions, not recovery hidden in Verify.

limitations.p: Verify does not accept enterprise routing, licensing, authentication, real app requests or AKS protections automatically.

say: A new terminal is not guaranteed to refresh VS Code's inherited environment.
Native and full Verify are distinct positive scopes; required failure is never ignored.
Five Native or twelve full IDs still need actual profile, enablement and approved routing acceptance.
evidence_gaps: No laptop Verify exit 0, source/profile acceptance, runtime-health or authentication observation is recorded by the companion.
